query:
SELECT d.id AS "id!: crate::design::DesignId",
    d.owner_id AS "owner_id!: crate::account::AccountId",
    d.slug AS "slug!", d.name AS "name!", d.default_branch AS "default_branch!",
    d.visibility AS "visibility!", a.handle AS "handle!", 'owner' AS "role!",
                to_char(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') AS created_at
         FROM design d JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id
         WHERE d.owner_id = $1
         UNION ALL
         SELECT d.id AS "id!: crate::design::DesignId",
    d.owner_id AS "owner_id!: crate::account::AccountId",
    d.slug AS "slug!", d.name AS "name!", d.default_branch AS "default_branch!",
    d.visibility AS "visibility!", a.handle, r.role,
                to_char(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US')
         FROM design_role r
         JOIN design d ON d.id = r.design_id
         JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id
         WHERE r.account_id = $1
         ORDER BY created_at DESC, 1 DESC
